title: 第3279章 电话沟通误会第3278章 阴差阳错
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
蔡明萱从小没有体会到全心全意爱一个人是什么感觉，她母亲早亡，所以不知道夫妻和睦顺遂又该是什么样的。
之前遇到秦伏天的时候，即便她已经察觉自己动心了，依旧会犹豫不决，不知道应该怎么做。
她还是第一次遇到像欧阳红玉这般果决的人。
难道欧阳红玉对秦伏天就没有一丝丝迟疑吗？
看出了蔡明萱的疑惑，欧阳红玉只是笑了笑，主动邀请道：“你要跟我一起练吗？我可以教你。”
蔡明萱闻言更加震惊，忍不住询问道：“如果我跟你一起过去寻找秦公子，你就不担心我……”
没等她将话说完，欧阳红玉就笑了起来。
“当然不担心，如果伏天哥哥对你有意思，我不会阻止，像他那样优秀的男人，原本就不可能只有一个女人。”
欧阳红玉没说的是，她太了解秦伏天了。
秦伏天敢爱敢恨，敢作敢当，如果秦伏天真的看上了蔡明萱，蔡明萱根本不可能被留在江云市。
既然如此，带蔡明萱过去又何妨？
只要这个女人不拖后腿，能够为秦伏天提供些许助力，欧阳红玉根本不在乎这个女人抱着什么心思，是否对她暗含敌意。
很快，欧阳红玉就给秦伏天发去了消息。
没过多久，她就收到了秦伏天的电话。
因为这个世界的电话可能会被人监听，欧阳红玉虽然激动，却没有询问秦伏天任何信息，只将自己的情况如实告诉了秦伏天，并表达出想要和秦伏天汇合的想法。
刚刚到达繁花镇的秦伏天，在得知欧阳红玉没事，只是修为消失，也暗暗松了口气。
不过，想到黑蛇会和龙婆谷的情况，秦伏天并没有让欧阳红玉现在过来。
根据秦伏天得到的情报，黑蛇会以魔修着称，龙婆谷以鬼修着称，手段一个比一个诡异莫测。
根据方淼淼的讲述，传闻中这两个势力背后，甚至还有实力堪比飞升仙人的顶级强者。
秦伏天估摸着，那至少是与神君、仙君实力相当的人物。

如果单打独斗，秦伏天不需要担心，但如果身边跟着太多人，遇到这等实力的敌人，他未必能护所有人周全。
相比之下，江云市更加安全，能够让欧阳红玉潜心修炼。
“等我解决这边的事情，就回去跟你汇合。”
秦伏天柔声说道，脸上浮现出淡淡的笑意。
在欧阳红玉的依依不舍中，秦伏天又叮嘱道：“你在国内如果有机会，可以留意玉石相关的东西，说不定会对你有帮助。
一切以自身安全为主，等我回去。”
得到秦伏天的许诺，欧阳红玉彷徨许久的心一下安定下来。
她乖巧地应了一声，虽然依旧不舍，但还是挂掉电话，以免耽误秦伏天太多时间。
秦伏天也收起手机，回到大厅之中。
这里是繁花镇方家购买的别墅，是方家族人过来办事或游玩时落脚的地方。
位于城镇中心，繁华热闹。
高耸的围墙，与茂密的热带植被，将别墅与外面繁杂的游客隔离开来，颇有闹中取静的意思。
content_en:
Cai Mingxuan has never experienced what it feels like to love someone wholeheartedly since she was a child. Her mother died young, so she doesn't know what it is like to be harmonious and smooth between husband and wife.
When she met Qin Futian before, even though she had noticed that she was attracted, she was still hesitant and didn't know what to do.
This was the first time she met someone as decisive as Ouyang Hongyu.
Doesn't Ouyang Hongyu have any hesitation about Qin Futian?
Seeing Cai Mingxuan's doubts, Ouyang Hongyu just smiled and actively invited: "Do you want to practice with me? I can teach you."
Cai Mingxuan was even more shocked when she heard this, and couldn't help but ask: "If I go with you to look for Mr. Qin, you won't worry about me..."
Before she could finish her words, Ouyang Hongyu started laughing.
"Of course I'm not worried. If Brother Futian is interested in you, I won't stop him. It's impossible for a man as good as him to have only one woman."
What Ouyang Hongyu didn't say was that she knew Qin Futian too well.
Qin Futian dares to love, hate, and act. If Qin Futian really falls in love with Cai Mingxuan, there is no way that Cai Mingxuan will be left in Jiangyun City.
In this case, why not take Cai Mingxuan there?
As long as this woman doesn't hold back and can provide some help to Qin Futian, Ouyang Hongyu doesn't care what the woman's intentions are and whether she has any hidden hostility towards her.
Soon, Ouyang Hongyu sent a message to Qin Futian.
Not long after, she received a call from Qin Futian.
Because the phone calls in this world may be monitored, although Ouyang Hongyu was excited, she did not ask Qin Futian for any information. She only told Qin Futian the truth about her situation and expressed her desire to join Qin Futian.
Qin Futian, who had just arrived in Fanhua Town, was secretly relieved when he learned that Ouyang Hongyu was fine, but that his cultivation level had disappeared.
However, thinking of the situation between Black Snake and Long Po Valley, Qin Futian did not let Ouyang Hongyu come over now.
According to the information obtained by Qin Futian, the Black Snake Society is famous for its demonic cultivators, and Long Po Valley is famous for its ghost cultivators, and their methods are more bizarre and unpredictable than the last.
According to Fang Miaomiao, it is rumored that behind these two forces, there are even top powerhouses who are as powerful as ascended immortals.
Qin Futian estimated that he was at least as powerful as the Divine Lord and the Immortal Lord.
If he fights alone, Qin Futian doesn't need to worry, but if there are too many people around him, he may not be able to protect everyone when he encounters an enemy of this strength.
In comparison, Jiangyun City is safer and allows Ouyang Hongyu to concentrate on training.
"When I solve the matter here, I will go back and join you."
Qin Futian said softly, with a faint smile on his face.
In Ouyang Hongyu's reluctance, Qin Futian warned again: "If you have the opportunity in China, you can pay attention to jade-related things, maybe it will be helpful to you.
Everything is for your own safety, wait until I return. "
After receiving Qin Futian's promise, Ouyang Hongyu's heart, which had been hesitating for a long time, suddenly settled down.
She responded obediently, and although she was still reluctant to give up, she still hung up the phone so as not to waste too much of Qin Futian's time.
Qin Futian also put away his mobile phone and returned to the hall.
This is the villa purchased by the Fang family in Fanhua Town. It is where the Fang family members stay when they come to do business or play.
Located in the center of town, bustling and lively.
The towering walls and dense tropical vegetation isolate the villa from the crowds of tourists outside, creating a sense of tranquility amidst the bustle.
